translation_notes: context shim context_shim.py: pyduktape2 (Duktape binding) is not installed; JSProxy reduced to what the region uses (isinstance + toPython(), AttributeError when the JS object has no toPython). original.py and translated.ldpy import it from the shim.

binding restoration: the region is a module-level @classmethod, which is not callable by itself; both sides end with the same class + alias `build = SHACLJSContext.build_results_as_shacl_function` (identical on both sides) so the driver can call it.

Literal(str(res), datatype=XSD["decimal"]) -> f"{res}"^^xsd:decimal (typed literal with an f-string lexical form; same rdflib constructor, so inf -> Infinity and 1e-05 -> 0.00001 normalisation agree, verified by the driver). `{res}^^xsd:decimal` is NOT available here: outside a graph island the suffix after `{expr}` does not parse (set display followed by ^^), only a quoted string takes ^^ in plain Python position.

Literal(res, datatype=XSD["boolean"]) on a bool -> f{res}: the default coercion of a bool IS xsd:boolean "true" (rdflib infers it), checked equal; f"{res}"^^xsd:boolean also agrees on True/False only because rdflib normalises the lexical "True" (equivalent mutant, left out).

MISSING: the three other Literal(...) sites (`Literal(lex, datatype=return_type, normalize=False)` twice, once with a datatype computed at run time, and `Literal(res, datatype=return_type, normalize=False)`) have no spelling in the language: `{x}^^{dt}` / `f".."^^{dt}` always go through rdflib normalisation, so "5"^^xsd:double becomes "5.0", "05"^^xsd:integer becomes "5", "True"^^xsd:boolean becomes "true", and b"x" would be "bx" (the driver kills the mutant that drops normalize=False). They are kept as Python Literal(...) calls: the island notation gives no gain there and cannot express normalize=False.
